transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, it’s a little hard to explain. I’ve just been noticing some things lately. 

I know it probably sounds strange, but... I’ve been completely convinced that one of my MBA classmates and this startup advisor I know are... quietly coordinating opportunities for me. Like... just certain comments they make in class, or specific Slack messages. They really seem like coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. So... yeah. I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you ever felt like things people say or do, like comments or messages, have a special meaning for you that others don’t seem to notice?

Um... yeah. That's... kind of what I was just trying to say. Like with the Slack messages, or... the things they say in class. It just feels like they're coded specifically for me, about my career. I don't think anyone else picks up on it. So... yes.
Do you think these messages or comments are meant only for you, or do you believe others might also be receiving similar signals?

Um... just me. Like I said, the... the messages are about where my career is supposed to go. The opportunities they're coordinating are for me. So... no, I don't think they're doing it for anyone else.
Do you believe these messages are meant to help you, or do you feel like they might be trying to harm you in some way?
Um... help me, I think. I mean... like I said, it's about coordinating opportunities for me. So... yeah. Just to help.
Do you feel like these messages are part of a bigger, organized plan or system that’s guiding you, or do you think they’re just occasional helpful hints?

Um... yeah, I guess it feels like a plan. I know it probably sounds hard to explain, but... I've just been really convinced that they're working together on it. Um... specifically one of my MBA classmates and... this startup advisor. They're the ones quietly coordinating these opportunities for me. So... yeah, it's organized.
Do these coordinated messages feel like part of a continuous, well-organized system that affects how you understand and interact with the world around you?

Um... yeah, I guess you could say that. Like I said... I know it sounds strange, but... I've just been so sure they're doing this. The classmate and the advisor. It's... it's just the way they use those coded signals, you know? In class or on Slack... telling me where my career is supposed to go. So... yeah, I guess it affects how I see things.
Even if others might not see these signals or agree that they’re meant for you, do you still feel completely certain that they are real and intended for you?

Um... yeah. I mean, I know other people probably don't see it. I know it sounds... hard to explain to anyone else. But... yes. I've just been completely convinced that it's real. The comments... the Slack messages... they're coded signals. I just... I know they're for me.
Have you ever felt like things happening around you, like people's actions or events, are directly related to you, even if they don't seem connected to others?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Like I was saying before... it's just the things they do. The comments... the messages. I just feel like they're connected to me... pointing me in a certain direction. Even if no one else sees it.
Do you feel that these messages or signals are not only meant for you, but also that they relate to something very important about you, like you have a special role or destiny that others don’t?

Um... I don't know about a special destiny or anything like that. I just... I came in because, like I said, I've been convinced they're coordinating these opportunities for me. The classmate... the advisor. It's just... the comments and the Slack messages. I just feel like they're telling me where my career is supposed to go. That's all.
Do you think other people could perceive this system of messages if they paid close attention, or is it something that only you can truly understand?

Um... no, I don't think anyone else would notice. It's... it's quiet. The way my classmate and the advisor are coordinating it all... it's just meant for me. So if someone else looked at the Slack messages or heard the comments, they wouldn't see the coded signals. They're... they're specifically about where my career is supposed to go. So... yeah. Just me.
Do you feel like the way these signals are communicated to you follows a consistent pattern or system that makes complete sense to you, even if others might not understand it?

Um... yeah, I guess it makes sense to me. It's just... like I said, I've just been convinced they're coordinating these opportunities. The comments in class... the Slack messages... they're just coded signals. It's... it's a pattern about where my career is supposed to go. I know it sounds hard to explain... but that's just how it is.
Do these signals or messages ever feel so real or compelling that they change how you act or make decisions in your daily life?

Um... yeah, I guess they do. I mean, like I keep saying... I've just been completely convinced they're coordinating things for me. So... if I see one of those Slack messages or hear a certain comment from my classmate or the advisor... I follow it. I use those coded signals to figure out what to do next with my career. That's... kind of why I came in, I guess. Because I'm acting on it.
Even when others might tell you that these signals aren't real or that you're misinterpreting things, do you still firmly believe that these messages are genuine and meant for you?

Um... yeah. I mean, I know it sounds... like I said, hard to explain to other people. But... I'm still completely convinced. The classmate, the advisor... they're coordinating it. The Slack messages, the comments... they're meant for me. It's... it's about my career. So... yeah, I still believe it.
Even if there’s no clear proof that these signals are real or others don’t see them, do you still believe with absolute certainty that they are true and meant for you?

Um... yes. I mean, I know I keep repeating myself, but... yes. Even without proof, I'm... I'm completely convinced. The classmate, the advisor... they're coordinating it. The comments, the messages... they're coded signals for me. About my career. I... I know it's hard for anyone else to understand, but... that's just how it is.
Have you ever questioned whether these signals might just be coincidences or normal interactions that you've given extra meaning to?

Um... I don't really know. I mean... I know I said I came in because it sounds hard to explain to people. But... no, I haven't really questioned it. I'm just... I'm completely convinced that my classmate and the startup advisor are coordinating things. The Slack messages, the comments... they're coded signals about my career. I just... I don't see them as coincidences.
